# Neuri

> Neuri (Neuri LLC, Phoenix, AZ) builds AI agents for small businesses anywhere, in Spanish and English. Four products: neuri.bots, neuri.bazar, neuri.consulting and neuri.marketing (coming soon). Contact: hola@neuri.tech

Neuri crea agentes de IA para negocios de cualquier país, en español e inglés: neuri.bots contesta tus DMs de Instagram y Messenger, neuri.bazar lleva la caja y los vendedores de tu bazar, y neuri.consulting te ayuda a poner la IA a trabajar.

## neuri.bots

Answers Instagram and Messenger DMs for small sellers from the seller's own sheet: "is this still available?", price and payment, holds items and DMs a link to people who comment. It does not make things up: unknown questions go to the owner. The direct Instagram/Messenger connection is pending Meta's approval; WhatsApp is on the way. Month to month, no contract; setup and first month free for the first 10 sellers.

- Básico MXN 899/mes · Pro MXN 1,299/mes
- Basic US$49/month · Pro US$69/month
- [neuri.bots (español)](https://neuri.tech/sigue-disponible/) · [English](https://neuri.tech/en/still-available/)

## neuri.bazar

Point of sale for consignment bazaars, tianguis, antique malls, vendor malls and makers markets that rent booths: ring up sales on a phone; each vendor's sales, rent and payouts add up automatically. 14 days free.

- Básico MXN 499 · Pro MXN 899 · Plus MXN 1,499 al mes
- Basic US$79 · Pro US$119 · Plus US$149 per month
- Basic: up to 30 vendors and 1 register · Pro: up to 75 vendors and 3 registers · Plus: unlimited vendors and registers, plus a public website with the whole inventory. Flat monthly price, no fee on sales.
- [neuri.bazar (español)](https://neuri.tech/bazar/) · [English](https://neuri.tech/en/) · [Recorrido con pantallas reales](https://neuri.tech/bazar/recorrido/) · [Tour with real screens](https://neuri.tech/en/bazar/tour/)

## neuri.consulting

AI consulting for companies: a virtual AI diagnostic, then implementation of agents that prospect customers, automate operations and deliver reporting. Diagnostic from MXN 4,500 / US$249.

- [Neuri Consulting (español)](https://neuri.tech/consultoria/) · [English](https://neuri.tech/en/ai-consulting/)
- [Diagnostic site and pricing](https://consulting.neuri.tech/precios) · [llms.txt](https://consulting.neuri.tech/llms.txt)

## neuri.marketing (coming soon)

AI marketing hub for small businesses: brand kit, a 30-day content calendar, posts and reels drafted with the business's own photos, one-tap approval, then scheduling on Instagram and Facebook. Not available yet — waitlist open; no pricing published. Free tools that work today, no sign-up: 2026 guide, profile self-check, templates by business type, 24 reel ideas with 3-shot scripts, 17 ready-to-copy comment replies, brand sheet.

- [neuri.marketing (español)](https://neuri.tech/marketing/) · [English](https://neuri.tech/en/marketing/)
- Free tools: [2026 guide](https://neuri-marketing-production.up.railway.app/guia) · [Profile self-check](https://neuri-marketing-production.up.railway.app/diagnostico) · [Templates by business type](https://neuri-marketing-production.up.railway.app/plantillas) · [Reel ideas](https://neuri-marketing-production.up.railway.app/ideas-reels) · [Comment replies](https://neuri-marketing-production.up.railway.app/respuestas) · [Brand sheet](https://neuri-marketing-production.up.railway.app/marca) (English: add ?lang=en)
